443-2438-2738-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2438-2738-4871-6026.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Field of Souls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2111-5330-6792.description:

When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

Move to your next turn.

When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning The Immortal Weapons from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When The Immortal Weapons enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing The Immortal Weapons, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

670-1603-1619-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares

913-1170-2440-7577.easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
913-1170-2440-7577.description:
Cast the copy of Swords to Plowshares from exile by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Emeritus of Truce.
When Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares enters, it and Mana Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Emeritus of Truce trigger, causing an opponent to create a 1/1 Inkling creature token with flying and preparing Emeritus of Truce.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C} since Displacer Kitten and Emeritus of Truce are both Cats.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares, exiling a creature an opponent controls and causing them to gain life.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat any number of times.
If the board state allows, create an Inkling token in step 4 instead of targeting an opponent.
913-1170-2440-7577.notes: The exact results depend on the board state, but you should typically be able to reach a point where an opponent has more creatures than you and get the most beneficial combination of results.

147-413-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-413-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.

When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bloodghast trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

372-813-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.

Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.

747-974-1651-2003-3263.manaNeeded: {4}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G} if you don't control a Smaug token
747-974-1651-2003-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Go-Shintai does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
747-974-1651-2003-3263.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
If you control two Smaugs, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If you do, the Smaug that died triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
If you made Treasures this way, activate nine Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Go-Shintai by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's first chapter ability triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you.
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two lore counters on There and Back Again.
There and Back Again's second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping four artifacts, untapping Contagion Engine and Go-Shintai.
Resolve the second There and Back Again trigger, causing you to search your library for a Mountain and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the third There and Back Again trigger, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Repeat from step 3.

851-2034-2775.description:

Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Slimefoot twice, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain two life.
